customManagers.description: Renovate CLI of the self-hosted run: the workflow pins ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate to 44.261.1, the current npm latest.

packageRules.description: An overrides entry is a forced version with no consumer range check on Renovate's side (it reads the manifest, not the consumers): a major bump must be approved in the dashboard, never merged reflexively — #275 forced fast-uri 4.2.4 under ajv's ^3.0.1
One PR for all dev dependency bumps
One PR for Dockerfile and docker-compose base images
The action appends the CLI value to the image name, so keep it a tag: no digest suffix
scripts/release.sh owns the stdio base pin (it moves the tag on every release); a digest pin here would silently outvote the new tag
